comment: Andrew-directed experiment (2026-06-12). Candidate removes the per-epoch validation pass (card_loss_simd over all batches + L2/sched penalty re-eval) and best-epoch selection entirely; num_epochs default 8->9 (the sanctioned compensation: dropping selection cannot improve loss by construction). Complexity 7985->7930 (ratio 0.9931, simpler). cosine-anneal t_max stretches to 9 epochs automatically. FSRS_N_EPOCHS env knob still works (hp-tune gold now (9,256)). cp-side spot numbers (informational): candidate not cp-timed this iter; the benchmark timing is the era metric per Andrew.
